$comment: Office Pools fork template. A desk or community can copy this, change the fields, and run a free-to-play pool of their own. No entry fee, no pot, no yield, no deposits. This file is a rules sheet, not a contract and not a way to raise money.
name: your pool name
disclaimer: free to play. bragging rights only. not a fund. no promises.

scoring.pvp: The coin with the higher USD price change over the round wins. Change is (close − open) / open from public market prints snapshotted at open and close. If a print is missing, that pair's round is void. Ties stand as ties. Every correct pick is a winner. A desk captain is drawn from the winning tickets with a published seed (the round id).
scoring.gvg: Equal-weighted average of each constituent coin's round price change. Coins with no print are skipped, not zeroed. If a series has fewer than two priced coins, it is ineligible for that round.
scoring.weather: Yes or no: did El Segundo, California record measurable precipitation during the local calendar day? Settled from a public weather source (for example Open-Meteo or NWS).
scoring.nounDraw: Guess the head trait of the next official daily Noun. Settled from the public Nouns auction result. Ties among correct guesses share the plaque; a desk captain may be drawn from them.

entry.identity: clock-in name, or optional wallet address for display only

settlement: A backend should snapshot prices at open and close, freeze entries at the bell, publish the tape, and write winners. This prototype stores entries in localStorage only.
